claims.claim_text: Implemented and checkpointed a 37,462,528-parameter, 8-layer decoder Transformer with GQA 8/4, RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, tied embeddings, and context 1024.
claims.limitations: Architecture validation is not a claim of broad language ability.

claims.claim_text: Trained a native 24K byte-level BPE tokenizer with zero validation UNKs and exact normalized round-trip success.
claims.limitations: Tokenizer corpus and revision are bounded and pinned.

claims.claim_text: Completed BF16 pretraining for 50,003,968 processed tokens and 3,052 optimizer steps; fixed validation loss improved 10.1964 to 4.6484 and PPL 26,805.55 to 104.42.
claims.limitations: 50.0M processed tokens are 1.554 corpus passes, not 50M unique tokens; no strong general-language claim.

claims.claim_text: Verified exact checkpoint resume for model, optimizer, scheduler, and RNG state.
claims.limitations: Bounded control on the qualified local environment.

claims.claim_text: Built a leakage-controlled native SFT dataset with 4,800/700/700 train/validation/test rows, zero semantic-key overlap, 6,200 complete targets with supervised EOS, and no truncation.
claims.limitations: Two deterministic synthetic tasks; T1 shares category vocabulary and T2 stays in 0-99.

claims.claim_text: Completed 300-step full-parameter BF16 response-only SFT of all 37,462,528 parameters; validation loss improved 5.9922 to 0.5943 in 48.87 seconds.
claims.evidence_metric: selected checkpoint step=300; median=12188 input tok/s; peak allocated=1003.63 MiB
claims.limitations: One seed and one synthetic two-task mixture.

claims.claim_text: Native SFT improved T1 support classification from 0/64 to 64/64 on a fixed independent test subset.
claims.limitations: This is a 64-example subset of the 300-row T1 test split, not full-test accuracy.

claims.claim_text: Native SFT did not acquire reliable two-digit addition: T2 improved only from 0/64 to 2/64 on the fixed test subset.
claims.limitations: Bounded synthetic task and subset, but clearly insufficient capability.

claims.claim_text: All 384 native-SFT evaluation generations were format-valid, complete, EOS-terminated, non-repetitive, and avoided length-limit termination.
claims.evidence_metric: 384 records across 2 tasks x 3 splits x 64
claims.limitations: Generation behavior is not equivalent to task correctness.

claims.claim_text: Completed the formal Qwen3-0.6B PEFT campaign: 12/12 LoRA/QLoRA runs, three seeds, 1,200 steps each, and 8,400 audited MATH-500/GSM8K outputs.
claims.limitations: Frozen 512-context protocol; Qwen Full SFT and 1024-context formal study were not completed.

claims.claim_text: Math CPT did not yield a general downstream reasoning improvement under the frozen PEFT protocol: LoRA transfer was negative and QLoRA was mixed.
claims.limitations: Applies only to the frozen context, datasets, adapter settings, and three seeds.

claims.claim_text: The formal PEFT generation campaign had 8,398/8,400 outputs reach max_new_tokens=512.
claims.limitations: This observation alone does not prove why the models failed to stop.

claims.claim_text: Improved evaluator extraction on frozen outputs: legacy 1,764/8,400; first-valid 2,008; last-valid 1,824; conflict-aware 1,793, with 607 conflicts exposed.
claims.limitations: Evaluator improvement, not model-capability improvement.

claims.claim_text: External answer-boundary stopping reduced post-answer redundant generation in the bounded S3 confirmation without improving autonomous EOS learning.
claims.evidence_metric: confirmation S3 reduced redundancy for 6/8 outputs; paired accuracy 3/8 unchanged
claims.limitations: Small confirmation set; external intervention, not a model improvement.

claims.claim_text: A controlled 64-step EOS-label ablation did not validate autonomous-stop improvement; the EOS-supervised arm emitted no autonomous <|im_end|> and hit 512 tokens on all four C0 prompts.
claims.limitations: One seed and four frozen confirmation problems.

claims.claim_text: Integrated experimental Manual, SDPA Math, SDPA Auto, and forced Flash backend selection while retaining Manual as the formal default.
claims.limitations: BF16 correctness gates failed and no qualified performance benchmark exists.

claims.claim_text: SDPA Math and Auto failed the frozen BF16 correctness/gradient/update gates; no speedup claim is supported.
claims.evidence_metric: Math BF16 logits max abs=0.15625; Auto=0.20703125
claims.limitations: Fixed single-batch gate and frozen tolerances.

claims.claim_text: Built-in FlashAttention was unavailable in the qualified Windows/PyTorch environment.
claims.limitations: Platform/build limitation; not a universal hardware claim.

claims.claim_text: torch.compile qualification was blocked by missing Triton; no compile speedup was measured.
claims.limitations: Environment limitation; eager execution remains formal.

claims.claim_text: Localized the BF16 Manual/SDPA Math split to the first attention context boundary and supported a different intermediate-precision/rounding mechanism without finding a semantic implementation defect.
claims.limitations: Exact SDPA internal instruction ordering remains unknown.

claims.claim_text: Qwen full-parameter SFT effectiveness was not formally evaluated in the completed campaign.
claims.limitations: Implementation and qualification history do not equal formal effectiveness evidence.

claims.claim_text: Distributed DDP/FSDP training was not executed or validated.
claims.evidence_metric: explicitly outside GPU-4C and no formal artifact
claims.limitations: No performance or correctness claim is permitted.

claims.claim_text: At context 512, 12,469/19,162 PEFT training samples retained a supervised assistant-end token (65.07%); 6,693 training samples lost it after truncation.
claims.limitations: Coverage is a confirmed data fact, not proof that missing EOS supervision caused length-limit generation.
